plugins.name: gitignore-guardian

plugins.name: skills-hygiene
plugins.description: Manage Claude Code skill installations — deduplicate, promote, audit, internalize, and generalize skills across global and project levels.

plugins.name: agent-teams-workforce
plugins.description: A complete SDLC delivery workforce of bounded specialist agents, built on one principle: the agent is not the unit of trust — the workflow is. Each agent owns a single task category (plan, orchestrate, execute, approve, or test) with least-privilege tools; work moves through explicit artifacts and ends at gates that pass, loop, or escalate; no agent approves its own output, and the one that finds a flaw never fixes it. Realized as deterministic Workflow scripts — reusable gates and single-phase minis stitched into composites across two pipelines (PRD→Spec→Tasks and Spec→Deployment), a governance tier, and a parallel Documentation track.

plugins.name: self-improving-agent
plugins.description: Curate auto-memory, promote learnings to CLAUDE.md and rules, extract proven patterns into reusable skills.

plugins.name: research-summarizer
plugins.description: Structured research summarization — summarize academic papers, compare web articles, extract citations, and produce actionable research briefs.

plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: Catch-all bundle of frequently-used personal skills.

plugins.name: my-editor
plugins.description: Personal editing and writing-style toolkit with adhd-edit and my-style skills.

plugins.name: patent
plugins.description: Personal patent prep toolkit for inventors working with an attorney — router skill plus six sub-skills (ideation, patentability, claim drafting, enforceability, document generation, triage). Alice-safe framing, prior-art search across free public APIs, invention-disclosure and defensive-publication generation. Produces artifacts to hand to your lawyer; does not file with the USPTO. Uses only free, public data sources.

plugins.name: obsidian
plugins.description: Obsidian toolkit forked from kepano/obsidian-skills. Five Agent Skills — obsidian-cli (automate a running vault), obsidian-bases (v1.12+ database feature), obsidian-markdown (callouts, embeds, properties, wiki-links), json-canvas (.canvas authoring), and defuddle (web-to-Markdown). Adds platform + troubleshooting references to the CLI skill.

plugins.name: cds
plugins.description: Configurable Design System — a brand-neutral design-system plugin with skills that generate stylesheets, mocks, and framework-native component code for any host project.

plugins.name: forge
plugins.description: Tooling for the FORGE framework (Framework for Objective-Rooted, Gated Execution) — four skills to compose, revise, and review instructions an AI agent can execute without interpretation, and to distill READY implementation plans out of multi-purpose documents (steps in; decisions, history, notes, and open questions stay out; per-step execution state makes cross-session handoff and resume deterministic). Closes the gaps a human would otherwise leave for the agent to guess at, interactively or headlessly, and grades the result for interpretability and intent-fidelity risk.

plugins.name: memre
plugins.description: Memory-and-deliverable hygiene: a residue linter/fixer, a recordable-thing router with decision/memory/issue sinks, an auto-memory audit, and a markdown-to-beads memory importer.

plugins.name: okf
plugins.description: Open Knowledge Format (OKF) toolkit — author, convert, audit, enrich, and validate agent-readable knowledge bundles (markdown + YAML frontmatter). A router skill and interactive skills for in-the-loop work, plus bulk-work agents (okf-auditor, okf-bundle-builder, okf-enricher) that fan out over large trees in their own context. Bundled spec, conversion guides, and two deterministic scripts (conformance validator, index generator).
